summary: NetEase filed a Form 6-K attaching its Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated November 3, 2026, reporting routine share-count movements. On November 2, 2026 the issuer repurchased 5,180 ordinary shares (held as treasury shares) at USD 22.864 per share, trimming issued shares to 3,201,470,116 while treasury shares rose to 10,585,540 from 10,580,360. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing condition is stated. This is an ordinary open-market buyback disclosure, not a special situation; watch only for cumulative repurchase pace and treasury overhang.
